snippet.title: Nasteey
snippet.description: What's up guys my name Trevor but most people know me as Nasteey.  In the real world I'm just a 21 year old kid attending college, studying communications, and trying to make it in  the world. Online I'm a former challenger player, support main, and content creator trying to grow in the League of Legends community on Twitch and YouTube.  I provide in-depth advice including champion guides, key tips and tricks, coaching videos, and game analysis, just to name a few.  I upload on a fairly inconsistent schedule due to real life issues and school but try my hardest to pump out content through it all.  With that being said, I would like to briefly thank each and every single one of you for your patience and continued support.  It truly does mean the world to me.
